description: Railway Track Centreline (PTV) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Curated and Published by City of Casey, sourced from data.vic.gov.au. This dataset provides the locations and information of railway lines passing through the City of Casey. Sourced from Public Transport Victoria (via data.vic.gov.au). Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Community, Transport. Its keywords are Community, Transport, Train, Public, Railway, Railway Corridor. The portal shows 43 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
